sloka: स तस्यां जनयामास यदपत्यं निबोध तत् ।वज्रमुष्टिर्विरूपाक्षोदुर्मुखश्चैव राक्षसः ।। ७.५.३६ ॥
transliteration: sa tasyāṁ janayāmāsa yadapatyaṁ nibodha tat ।vajramuṣṭirvirūpākṣodurmukhaścaiva rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.5.36 ॥

translations.english: He begot in her the following offspring: Vajramushti, Virupaksha, and Durmukha, who were Rākṣasas.
